**Notes**
DockKeeper is intentionally small and reliability-first. Some things are
explicitly out of scope for v1 and tracked for later (follow-mouse /
follow-window modes, Shortcuts/Raycast integration, per-app rules, App Store
distribution) — see `docs/implementation-plan.md`. Anything requiring
telemetry, accounts, or network use is out of scope permanently (PRIVACY.md).
